name: lookup_appointment
description: Look up an existing appointment. Both the booking reference and the phone number given at booking are required — if the phone does not match the booking the tool returns {ok:false, error:"phone_mismatch"} and you must not try other numbers. Use it when the caller asks what time their appointment is, or before a change.

booking_ref.description: The booking reference in the form GAL-XXXXX.

phone.description: The phone number given when the appointment was booked.
